Sett.teamfight: Don’t engage from the front; clean up targets who are already caught from the flank or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock Sett back and escape. Push the opposite side lane if your team can hold; if the fight is about to collapse, join early with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker follows damage taken with a shield and a powerful counterattack, so after harassing him, create distance and wait for his Grit to cool down. When it activates, sidestep the center of its aim to avoid the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so don’t stand across from a group of minions with Sett between you and them.

Shen.build: The time spent taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash is dangerous, so prioritize tenacity. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so building only one type of resistance leaves you vulnerable to the other. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so stacking health alone is less valuable.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash misses and Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends, follow Quinn E Vault → empowered basic attack on the marked target → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → basic attack. The basic attack after Quinn E Vault consumes Quinn P Harrier’s mark and also activates the attack speed and movement speed increase from Quinn W Heightened Senses. Cast Quinn Q Blinding Assault when the path is clear so it doesn’t hit a minion first.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is an opportunity to engage with Quinn E Vault. However, if Shen R Stand United is still available, Shen may be able to escape, so check whether that ability has also been used. If Shen uses a mobility ability to go deeper into the enemy team, Quinn E Vault follows him, so check the landing spot before engaging.
Shen.fight: When Shen steps up to last-hit, briefly harass him with a basic attack on a Quinn P Harrier-marked target, then retreat. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, that’s an opportunity to close in with Quinn E Vault. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, wait to basic attack until it ends.
Shen.laning: Early on, use Quinn’s range and Quinn P Harrier marks to repeatedly get brief harass in when Shen goes to last-hit. Push the lane under Shen’s turret and make him collect CS, so choosing Shen R Stand United to go to another lane comes at a cost. After pushing the lane, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to affect another lane or the enemy jungle.
Shen.phase: Early on, Quinn can take lane control against Shen with mark-based harass. Quinn has a smaller role in frontal teamfights late, so pressure the side lanes and play around the map.
Shen.teamfight: Don’t be the first to engage from the front; clean up targets who are already caught from the flank or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock back enemies who close in and escape. If Shen uses Shen R Stand United to join another fight, alert your team and look for an opportunity to take advantage of his empty lane.
Shen.watch: If you’re taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you will be hit by basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so keep enough distance to avoid the dash. You can also reduce damage by moving out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault as his spirit blade returns. Stop basic attacking and keep your distance when Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is placed.

Singed.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of the poison trail. Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance if you build resistances. Singed E Fling scales with your maximum health, so be wary of choices that only add a lot of health.
Singed.combo: If you can engage without stepping on Singed W Mega Adhesive, attack in this order: Quinn E Vault → Quinn P Harrier empowered auto attack → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → auto attack. Quinn E Vault applies a mark, and the empowered auto attack activates Quinn W Heightened Senses' attack speed and movement speed bonus. In a short trade, use the marked auto attack first and save Quinn E Vault to knock him back as you disengage.
Singed.escape: Singed has no skill that creates distance on his own, so engage after dodging Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling, or confirming they have been used. You cannot use Quinn E Vault on the adhesive, so go around it to engage. If you could be hit by Singed E Fling, save Quinn E Vault to knock him back and escape instead of using it to engage.
Singed.fight: When Singed comes forward to last-hit, briefly harass him with an auto attack on Quinn P Harrier's mark. While Quinn W Heightened Senses grants attack speed and movement speed, add more auto attacks, then back off. If Singed closes in to retaliate, knock him back with Quinn E Vault. Unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure, do not chase even a low-health Singed along his poison trail.
Singed.laning: When your opponent steps outside the minion wave, hit them with Quinn Q Blinding Assault to mark the champion. After pushing the wave into the enemy turret, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to join another lane or the enemy jungle.
Singed.phase: Once Singed has his core items, he becomes hard to kill, and Quinn's role in late-game frontal teamfights shrinks, so apply pressure in a side lane.
Singed.teamfight: Do not go in from the front to chase Singed. If he charges at you, knock him back with Quinn E Vault, then target his allies or someone already caught out in the meantime. You can push the opposite side lane and join with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines, but join early if your team is about to collapse.
Singed.watch: Do not chase Singed while standing in Singed Q Poison Trail. You cannot escape Singed W Mega Adhesive with Quinn E Vault, and the follow-up Singed E Fling can root you, so go around the adhesive. If an enemy is behind Singed, Singed E Fling can send you toward them, so keep your distance.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and being hit by Sion E Roar of the Slayer also reduces your armor, so dodging it comes first. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that only add a lot of health.
Sion.combo: For a short trade, hit an empowered auto attack when Quinn P Harrier's mark appears, add one or two auto attacks while benefiting from Quinn W Heightened Senses, then end the trade by knocking him back with Quinn E Vault. If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down and you can engage safely, attack in this order: Quinn E Vault → marked empowered auto attack → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → auto attack. When using Quinn Q Blinding Assault, line it up so a minion is not hit first.
Sion.escape: You can find an opening to attack after dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or forcing him to use it early. Do not follow Sion with Quinn E Vault while he is charging with Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught.
Sion.fight: When Sion comes forward to last-hit, consume Quinn P Harrier's mark with an auto attack and briefly harass using the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses. If Sion closes in to retaliate, knock him back with Quinn E Vault as you retreat. Right after Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus your damage to break the shield first.
Sion.laning: From the early game, use your ranged advantage and Quinn P Harrier's mark to harass Sion as he last-hits, and avoid wasting the mark on minions. Quinn Q Blinding Assault will not mark Sion if a minion is hit first, so use it when Sion is outside the minion wave. Push the lane to disrupt Sion's farming, then use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines after pushing the wave in to gain an advantage elsewhere.
Sion.phase: Early on, Quinn can gain lane advantage with ranged harass and Quinn P Harrier's mark. As the game goes on, Sion gains maximum health by killing units, while Quinn's role in late-game frontal teamfights shrinks, so keep building an advantage through side-lane pressure.
Sion.teamfight: Do not engage head-on; clean up targets already caught out from the side or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock back a nearby enemy and escape, and avoid following Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught into the middle of the enemy team. If your team can hold, push the opposite side lane; if they are about to collapse, join early with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, dodge to the side instead of only backing away. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught also charges in an almost straight line, so avoid narrow paths and sidestep. After taking Sion down, reset your distance while watching for the fast attacks and maximum-health-based damage from Sion P Glory in Death.

Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If building resistances, prioritize magic resistance against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale, but magic resistance does not block Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or E Ixtal's Impact.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and you can engage safely, attack in this order: Quinn E Vault → marked empowered auto attack → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → auto attack. After Quinn E Vault, use an auto attack to activate Quinn W Heightened Senses' passive, and keep the trade short so you do not stay on Skarner for long.
Skarner.escape: The moment after you force Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is an opportunity to engage with Quinn E Vault. If Skarner R Impale is still available, keep enough distance that even if he suppresses you, he cannot pull you deep toward his allies.
Skarner.fight: When Skarner comes forward to last-hit, harass with an auto attack on Quinn P Harrier's mark, use the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses to attack briefly, then back off. While Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, do not use Quinn E Vault to engage; close the distance right after he uses that dash.
Skarner.laning: Use your ranged advantage to chip away at Skarner with marked auto attacks whenever he comes forward to last-hit. Quinn Q Blinding Assault will not mark Skarner if a minion is hit first, so fire it when he is outside the minion wave. After pushing the wave into Skarner's turret, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to join another lane or the enemy jungle.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Quinn can pressure melee opponents with marked harass. Later, Quinn's role in frontal teamfights shrinks, and Skarner's damage also increases with tank items, so use side-lane pressure.
Skarner.teamfight: Quinn should not engage head-on; clean up only targets already caught out from the side or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock back a nearby enemy and escape, and keep Skarner R Impale's short range and his allies' positions in mind. At the edge of an objective pit, Skarner R Impale can pull you through terrain, so do not stand against a wall.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain and stuns if it hits a wall, so do not stand with your back to a wall. If Skarner R Impale catches you, Quinn E Vault cannot break you free, so check your position before entering its short range.

Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first because Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap deal primarily magic damage. Also prepare Oracle Lens to clear traps from key paths.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down and you can engage, close in with Quinn E Vault to apply a mark. Immediately after landing, consume the mark with an empowered auto attack, then hit Quinn Q Blinding Assault and follow with an auto attack. If you use Quinn E Vault last, you cannot use the marked auto attack and Quinn W Heightened Senses' attack speed bonus on your earlier attacks.
Teemo.escape: After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is your opportunity to engage with Quinn E Vault. Teemo can gain speed with Teemo W Move Quick, so check your landing position before engaging, and avoid paths where Teemo R Noxious Trap may be placed. If you need Quinn E Vault for defense, knock back a nearby enemy and escape.
Teemo.fight: Start a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used. Consuming Quinn P Harrier's mark with an empowered auto attack lets you use the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses on your follow-up attacks. If you are blinded, use a skill such as Quinn Q Blinding Assault instead of auto attacks, or back off.
Teemo.laning: Avoid trades where you take one auto attack and retreat because of Teemo E Toxic Shot, and wait for Quinn P Harrier's mark and a window when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Hit Teemo with Quinn Q Blinding Assault when no minion blocks the path. After pushing the lane, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to join another lane or pressure Teemo with your jungler.
Teemo.phase: Early on, Quinn's harass with Quinn P Harrier's mark is strong, but you need to choose your trades while avoiding Teemo's blind and poison. Later, Quinn's role in front-to-back teamfights shrinks and Teemo's traps remain for a long time, so focus on side-lane pressure and checking your routes.
Teemo.teamfight: Do not engage head-on; clean up targets already caught out from the side. Save Quinn E Vault to knock back a nearby enemy and escape. In front of objectives and through narrow paths, use Oracle Lens to reveal and clear Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates Quinn's basic attacks, so do not try empowered auto attacks while blinded. Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison keeps dealing damage even after a single auto attack, so do not take a quick trade in range without being prepared. Teemo R Noxious Trap stealths and slows, so be careful when passing in front of objectives and through narrow paths.

Tryndamere.build: Build armor first against Tryndamere's physical damage and critical strikes. If healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust makes your harass ineffective, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Tryndamere.combo: A short trade goes in this order: auto attack on Quinn P Harrier's mark → extra auto attack with Quinn W Heightened Senses' passive → knockback with Quinn E Vault. If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down and you can engage, attack in this order: Quinn E Vault → empowered auto attack → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → auto attack. Use Quinn Q Blinding Assault from an angle where Tryndamere is outside the minion wave so a minion is not hit first.
Tryndamere.escape: If you engage first with Quinn E Vault while Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is available, you may follow his movement and land in a dangerous spot. Engage right after forcing Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, during a window when Tryndamere W Mocking Shout is also down. When retreating, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.fight: When Tryndamere comes forward to last-hit, briefly harass with an auto attack on Quinn P Harrier's mark. Use the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses to hit one or two more times, then if Tryndamere closes in, knock him back with Quinn E Vault as you retreat. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and attack again after it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Harass Tryndamere as he last-hits from the early game to limit both the critical strikes from Tryndamere P Battle Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. Do not spend Quinn P Harrier's mark on a minion while Tryndamere is in trading range. After pushing the wave into the enemy turret, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to create a numbers advantage in another lane or the enemy jungle.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, Quinn can dominate melee opponent Tryndamere with ranged marked harass. Later, Quinn's role in front-to-back teamfights shrinks, so apply side-lane pressure, but do not try to stop Tryndamere alone while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Quinn should not engage head-on; clean up targets already caught out from the side or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock Tryndamere back and escape if he approaches, and create distance while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active. Even if you are pushing the opposite side lane, join early with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines if your team is about to collapse.
Tryndamere.watch: Harass Tryndamere as he last-hits from the early game to limit the critical strikes from Tryndamere P Battle Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. If Tryndamere hits minions to build Fury, create distance, and save Quinn E Vault for when he closes in with Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, do not pour in damage; knock him back and let time run out.

Udyr.build: If harass is erased by healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Consider armor first, but account for the fact that armor cannot block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both damage types.
Udyr.combo: If you can engage safely, attack in this order: Quinn E Vault → empowered auto attack immediately after landing → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → auto attack. Quinn Q Blinding Assault will not mark Udyr if a minion is hit first, so fire it when he is outside the minion wave.
Udyr.escape: The moment after Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down is an opening to engage, but save Quinn E Vault to disengage if his stun is ready or he can move further in with a mobility skill. Immobilizing effects do not work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so create distance with Quinn E Vault after the empowerment ends.
Udyr.fight: When the P Harrier mark appears, use an empowered auto attack to gain the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses, then hit briefly and back off. After Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield is gone, continue attacking so he has no time to heal.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr comes forward to last-hit, harass with a marked auto attack, and if he closes in to retaliate, knock him back with Quinn E Vault and escape. When Udyr is in the jungle and is out of sight, do not advance; use vision on key paths and jungle entrances to track his route.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Quinn can chip away at Udyr with ranged marked harass before he closes in. In late-game front-to-back teamfights, Quinn's role shrinks, so play through side-lane pressure.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not force an attack on Udyr first while he is covered by defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle's shield; target weaker enemies behind him. Quinn should clean up targets already caught out from the side, and use Quinn E Vault to escape if Udyr closes in.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede approaches quickly and stuns, so create distance just after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals damage based on maximum health when he is close, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm slows, so chip away at his health before allowing him to approach.

Volibear.build: If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul makes your poke less effective, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Volibear P The Relentless Storm and E Sky Splitter.
Volibear.combo: A standard trade goes: P Harrier marked empowered basic attack → one or two basic attacks with the passive from Quinn W Heightened Senses → Quinn E Vault to knock him back as you disengage. If Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are down and you can engage, use Quinn E Vault → empowered basic attack right after landing → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → basic attack.
Volibear.escape: While Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, you have a safe chance to poke. Before going deep, check that both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are down. If either is still available, Quinn E Vault may follow his movement and land you in a dangerous position.
Volibear.fight: When a P Harrier mark appears, use an empowered basic attack to gain the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses, land one or two more attacks, then back off. If Volibear tries to close in with Q Thundering Smash, use Quinn E Vault to knock him back and create distance. Repeat short trades timed around the mark instead of taking long fights that let Volibear heal with W Frenzied Maul.
Volibear.laning: When Volibear steps up to last-hit, land a marked basic attack and back off immediately. Use your range advantage to poke while Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, and hit him with Quinn Q Blinding Assault when no minion blocks its path. Push the wave under the enemy turret, then use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to move to another lane or into the enemy jungle.
Volibear.phase: Early on, Quinn can gain lane advantage with ranged Harrier-mark poke. Later, Quinn has less of a role in front-to-back teamfights, so pressure a side lane and choose when to join your team.
Volibear.teamfight: Avoid engaging from the front; clean up targets already caught from the side or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock away Volibear when he gets on you and disengage. Avoid fighting while Volibear builds stacks of P The Relentless Storm as he approaches, and stay well back even under your turret while Volibear R Stormbringer is ready.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed as he closes in, then stuns with an empowered basic attack, so stay outside his attack range until it expires. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid the damage and slow. If Volibear R Stormbringer is ready, beware of dives even under your turret, and move away from the landing spot when you see him leap.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Attack speed reduction also helps lengthen the interval between Yasuo's basic attacks and delay how soon his tornado becomes available again. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Start a short trade with a Quinn P Harrier marked empowered basic attack, land one or two more basic attacks with the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses, then knock him back with Quinn E Vault and retreat. When engaging, after Yasuo W Wind Wall is down or disappears, use Quinn E Vault → empowered basic attack right after landing → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → basic attack. Use Quinn Q Blinding Assault when Yasuo is outside the minion line so it does not hit a minion first.
Yasuo.escape: Look to engage right after Yasuo throws his tornado and his stacks reset. If you use Quinn E Vault while Yasuo is moving with E Sweeping Blade or R Last Breath, Quinn may follow him and land in a dangerous spot, so check the enemy's mobility and whether your team can follow up.
Yasuo.fight: First remove the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke, then trade seriously. When a P Harrier mark appears, use a Quinn P Harrier empowered basic attack to gain the attack speed and movement speed from Quinn W Heightened Senses, hit briefly, then back off. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so look for a chance to engage.
Yasuo.laning: When Yasuo steps forward to last-hit, land a marked basic attack and briefly back off to chip away at his health. Manage the wave so there are fewer minions for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to use as stepping stones, and if he closes in, knock him back with Quinn E Vault and retreat. After pushing the lane, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to go to another lane or into the enemy jungle and create a numbers advantage.
Yasuo.phase: Later, Quinn has less of a role in front-to-back teamfights, so use side lane pressure.
Yasuo.teamfight: Do not engage from the front; clean up only targets already caught from the side or behind. Save Quinn E Vault to knock away Yasuo when he gets close and disengage. If your team can hold, push the opposite side lane; if the fight is about to collapse, join early.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after hitting twice, so when its stacks are ready, move sideways out of its line. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close in, so watch the nearby minions. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, hold Quinn Q Blinding Assault and go around the wall or wait for it to disappear.

Yone.build: The first item to buy cannot be determined from the information alone. Yone deals mixed damage, so building only one type of resistance makes it difficult to mitigate the other type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so prioritize movement speed to get out of its telegraphed area instead of stacking health.
Yone.combo: For a short trade, use a Quinn P Harrier marked basic attack to activate the passive from Quinn W Heightened Senses, land one or two more basic attacks, then finish by knocking him back with Quinn E Vault. When going all-in after checking Yone's remaining mobility, use Quinn E Vault → marked empowered basic attack → Quinn Q Blinding Assault → basic attack. Quinn E Vault follows the target's movement, so do not use it to engage when Yone can move deep into a dangerous area.
Yone.escape: Do not go in just because Yone E Soul Unbound is down; check Yone Q Mortal Steel and R Fate Sealed as well. In particular, look for a chance to close the distance with Quinn E Vault when Yone R Fate Sealed is not back yet and tornado Q is not ready. If Yone dives in first, use Quinn E Vault's forced movement to interrupt his approach and retreat.
Yone.fight: When Yone's tornado Q is not ready, use a Quinn P Harrier marked basic attack for a short trade. If Yone closes in to retaliate, knock him back with Quinn E Vault and retreat. Before looking to engage, first check which of Yone Q Mortal Steel, E Soul Unbound, and R Fate Sealed are still available as mobility tools.
Yone.laning: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, keep your distance and resume poking after the stacks disappear. After pushing the wave under the enemy turret, look for a chance to use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to appear in another lane or in the enemy jungle.
Yone.phase: Later, Quinn has less of a role in front-to-back teamfights, so push and pressure side lanes.
Yone.teamfight: Do not engage from the front; clean up targets already caught from the side or behind, and save Quinn E Vault to knock away enemies who get close and disengage. Space out from your team so several allies do not get hit together by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and check whether you are alone at the very back of your formation before Yone R Fate Sealed. If your team can hold, use Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines to keep pushing the opposite side lane; if the fight is about to collapse, join early.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, wait outside his range until the stacks disappear. After Yone engages with E Soul Unbound, he deals extra damage when he returns, so create distance first if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in champions along its path and moves him behind the last champion, so do not stand alone at the very back of your formation.

Yorick.build: Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage that scales with maximum health, so armor or health alone cannot fully protect you.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so if the ghouls are cleared, you can use Quinn E Vault to close the distance.
Yorick.fight: Look to engage once the ghouls are cleared and Yorick W Dark Procession is down.
Yorick.phase: Early on, Quinn can use ranged Harrier-mark poke to pressure melee Yorick.
